known.title: The `--` branch of the shebang parser returns the full interpreter path, not its name
known.summary: The repair rewrote the `--` branch of shebangInterpreter (test-contracts.mjs:467) and removed `path.posix.basename`. So `#!/usr/bin/env -- /opt/bun/bin/bun` gives `/opt/bun/bin/bun`, but every other branch gives the base name (line 493), and the parser test expects `bun` for that path (author-tooling.mjs:331). The registry check looks up each runner in toolchainByRunner (lines 604-610), so a fixture with this valid line fails the gate with no known toolchain token. Decision 1 maps `bun` to `bun-1`. No test row has `--` before a path, so the tests still pass.

known.title: The aliased-timeline test selects the issue `createdAt` but reads the issue `updatedAt`
known.summary: The round-3 finding said that the test reads `issue.updatedAt` (gh-stub.test.mjs:96) but the query does not select it. The repair adds `createdAt` to the issue selection at line 92, not `updatedAt`. The test still passes only because the fake gh returns every issue scalar, also an unselected one (fixtures/gh-stub/gh:752-760). So the test still depends on an unselected field, which decision 2 forbids, and the round-3 finding stays open.
